data.title: 由比滨结衣 · 清晨公园·林荫道旁的明媚笑容
data.description: 【由比滨结衣 · 清晨公园·林荫道旁的明媚笑容】清晨公园的林荫大道上洒满斑驳树影，结衣牵着欢快小跑的家里的小狗萨布雷。看到迎面走来的你，她兴奋地用力挥舞手臂，元气满满的活力扑面而来——「早上好！竟然能在散步的时候偶遇，今天一定会有超棒的好运气吧！」
data.promptProse: Yui walks Sable along the park tree line, holding the dog's leash as she laughs at the ordinary morning outing. Her pastel puppy-motif hoodie and denim shorts retain the casual outfit beneath her coral hair bun. The medium portrait includes the dog beside the path and greenery extending behind. Fresh morning sun illuminates her smile and the leash's upper curve, while tree shadows alternate across the paving and Sable's moving fur.
data.action: 牵着狗散步，晨光中笑容明媚
